title: SeatsReserved
description: All requested seats were held. Reservation is all-or-nothing, so seatIds equals the requested set.

orderId.description: The order this message concerns. Always equal to sagaId.

seatIds.description: Seat labels unique within the show, e.g. A12. Not globally unique.

lockExpiresAt.description: When the hold lapses. Strictly after occurredAt. The fencing field: a service confirming later compares this against now and compensates rather than confirming a seat someone else now holds.
